requirements.name: Breakdown of educational program / transcript evaluation
requirements.detail: BRN reviews foreign nursing education directly (California does not require CGFNS CES for licensure by exam, unlike some states).

requirements.name: English comprehension exam — only if the Board has reasonable doubt (CCR 1413)
requirements.detail: The BRN requires an exam only when it has reasonable doubt of the applicant's ability to comprehend English well enough to practise safely. The guideline names no specific test and no validity period.

requirements.name: NCLEX-RN
requirements.detail: National licensure exam; apply to BRN for eligibility.
depends_on: Breakdown of educational program / transcript evaluation

notes: California reviews transcripts itself and is stricter on concurrent theory+clinical hours; CGFNS CES is not the licensure gateway here. URL check 2026-09-13: https://www.rn.ca.gov/applicants/lic-intl.shtml and https://www.ncsbn.org/exams.htm returned 404 and were replaced with verified BRN/NCSBN pages. H7b 2026-09-13: per BRN guideline EDP-I-35 (CCR 1413) the Board requires an English exam only when it has reasonable doubt of the applicant's English comprehension, and names no test or validity period; req2 therefore no longer names TOEFL iBT / ETS, and its validity_months (was 24) and valid_at (was registration_decision) are null.
